matters.title: Matters

new.title: New matter
new.description: Add a matter by hand. You can add its proceedings and people next.
new.titleHint: For example: Rao v. State of Tamil Nadu
new.sensitiveHint: AI processing is turned off for this matter and it is excluded from bulk imports and shared briefs

errors.failed: Couldn't create the matter. Try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. Changes will not save until you're back.

empty.title: No matters yet
empty.body: Share a cause list or an order to your Inbox, or add a matter by hand.

matters.offline: You're offline. Showing the last saved matters. Changes will not save until you're back.
matters.denied: Your role can't see this. Ask the chamber owner.

menu.label: Matter actions
menu.removeHint: AI processing, bulk imports and shared briefs will be available for this matter again.
menu.announceOff: This matter is no longer sensitive.

nextDate.title: Next date
nextDate.noneBody: Add a proceeding and its next listing to see the next date here.
nextDate.failed: Couldn't confirm the date. Try again.

conflict.title: Two dates for one proceeding
conflict.body: The sources disagree. Choose the date to keep, or enter the right one.
conflict.dateRequired: Enter a date from today onwards.
conflict.failed: Couldn't save the date. Try again.
conflict.stale: This conflict was already resolved. Showing the latest dates.

proceedings.title: Proceedings
proceedings.empty: No proceedings recorded. Add the case number you have, even before it is numbered (SR or FR number).

obligations.title: Open obligations
obligations.count: {count, plural, =0 {No open obligations} one {# open obligation} other {# open obligations}}

documents.title: Recent documents
documents.empty: Share or drop files into your Inbox
documents.label: {kind}, {status}

people.title: People
people.empty: No people recorded for this matter yet.

synopsis.title: Synopsis
synopsis.label: Synopsis
synopsis.emptyBody: A few lines on what this matter is about and where it stands.
synopsis.denied: Your role can't see the synopsis. Ask the chamber owner.
synopsis.failed: Couldn't save the synopsis. Try again.

workspace.offlineAction: You're offline. Changes will not save until you're back.

notFound.title: This matter doesn't exist or you can't open it.

proceedingsTab.title: Proceedings
proceedingsTab.mergeIn: Merge a matter into this one

split.title: Move proceedings to a new matter
split.description: The selected proceedings and their obligations move to a new matter. You can undo for 10 seconds.
split.titleRequired: Give the new matter a title.
split.crossing: {count, plural, =0 {No links cross the split} one {# link stays across the two matters} other {# links stay across the two matters}}
split.done: Proceedings moved to a new matter.

proceedingsTab.splitHint: Select the proceedings to move, then continue.
proceedingsTab.splitContinue: {count, plural, =0 {Continue} one {Continue with # proceeding} other {Continue with # proceedings}}

empty.title: No proceedings recorded
empty.body: Add the case number you have, even before it is numbered (SR or FR number).

transition.title: Move {label} to {state}?
transition.numberRequired: Enter the number and year the registry gave.
transition.reasonRequired: Give a reason for reopening a disposed proceeding.
transition.failed: Couldn't change the state. Try again.
transition.stale: The state changed since. Showing the latest.

form.description: Add what you have. An SR or FR number is enough before the case is numbered.
form.noForums: No forums yet. Add one in Courts.
form.caseTypeHint: Pick from the court's list or type it as printed.
form.caseTypeFreeText: Not in the court's list. It will be saved as typed.
form.invalidCnr: A CNR is 16 letters and digits.
form.duplicate: Looks like {label} which is already here. Merge?
form.failed: Couldn't save the proceeding. Try again.

merge.title: Merge another matter into this one
merge.description: Its proceedings, documents and obligations move here. You can undo for 10 seconds.
merge.searchHint: Type a title, party or case number.
merge.proceedingsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No proceedings} one {# proceeding} other {# proceedings}}
merge.documentsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}}
merge.obligationsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No obligations} one {# obligation} other {# obligations}}

blocked.sensitive: A sensitive matter can only be merged with another sensitive matter. AI processing is off for sensitive matters, so merging would expose its documents.
blocked.restricted: These matters are restricted to different people, so they can't be merged.
blocked.merged: One of these matters was already merged.
blocked.archived: An archived matter can't be merged or split.

undo.conflict: Something changed since. Nothing was undone.
